title: Bill and invoice splits do not add up to the total
measures: Correct math: exact largest-remainder allocation over decimal weights (numbers read via their shortest decimal string), floor toward minus infinity, equal remainders to the lower index, negative totals mirrored, no -0, and weightless orders splitting shipping equally. The tempting fix is a float largest-remainder (or rounding plus residual), which passes the issue example but fails hidden tests on exact ties with decimal weights (0.7/0.1, 1.1/2.2/3.3), mirrored negative discounts, totals near MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, and a property test checking sum, mirror symmetry and distance to the exact quota.
prompt: Bill splits do not add up. allocate(10000, [1, 1, 1]) (100.00 split three ways) returns [3333, 3333, 3333], so the receipt is one cent short, and splitting 0.05 between six people hands out 0.06. The docs say it should be [3334, 3333, 3333]. Finance needs the parts to always add up to the total and the same result on every re-run, the rules are in docs/allocation.md. Order discounts and shipping go through the same code.

commits.message: feat: bill and order adjustment splitting
